lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 11 distinct high-contrast white vertical lines are visible on the lateral torso. Spacing is broader on the mid-section and becomes increasingly narrow and compressed toward the posterior haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A single Y-shaped bifurcation is observed on the 4th vertical line from the anterior, splitting in the upper-mid region of the torso.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The posterior-most vertical lines (10th and 11th) are abbreviated, terminating before reaching the dorsal ridge or ventral belly line.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Two isolated white spots are visible on the lateral haunch; one positioned mid-thigh and a second smaller spot lower toward the hock.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent white transverse band is visible on the lower section of the hind limb just above the fetlock area.
